description: This file defines the EKYCService class responsible for managing an electronic Know Your Customer (eKYC) process, including initiating verification, verifying webhook signatures, and handling webhook payloads to update records.

classes.name: EKYCService
classes.description: Service handling mock eKYC flow and webhooks.

methods.name: Tuple[str,EKYCRecord] initiate(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Initiate a mock eKYC, returning a provider_ref and record.

methods.name: bool verify_webhook(self, payload: Dict, signature: str)
methods.description: Verify webhook signature with shared secret.

methods.name: EKYCRecord handle_webhook(self, payload: Dict, signature: str)
methods.description: Handle webhook: update record status based on payload.
